description: This file contains utility functions for processing nested tensors in the context of nested transformer models on CUDA devices. It includes functions to compute cumulative sequence lengths, max sequence lengths, checks for storage contiguity, and reshaping/broadcasting of nested tensors for efficient attention kernel execution.

classes.name: NestedTensorImpl
classes.description: Class representing the internal implementation of nested tensors, providing methods to access nested sizes, strides, storage offsets, and storage as tensors.

methods.name: int64_t get_nnz(const Tensor & nestedtensor)
methods.description: Calculates the total number of non-zero (nnz) elements in a nested tensor by summing the lengths of individual sequences.

methods.name: std::tuple<Tensor,int64_t,int64_t> cumulative_and_max_seq_len_nnz(const Tensor & qkv)
methods.description: Computes the cumulative sequence lengths for a batch of nested tensors, the maximum sequence length, and total nnz, returning a tuple with these metrics.

methods.name: bool is_safe_to_get_storage_as_tensor(const NestedTensorImpl * tensor)
methods.description: Checks whether a nested tensor's storage layout is safe for direct tensor views without calling contiguous, based on stride and offset patterns.

methods.name: at::Tensor view_as_dense(const at::Tensor & input_nestedtensor,const int64_t Nnz,const int64_t num_heads,const int64_t head_dim,const bool batch_needs_broadcast=false,const bool num_heads_needs_broadcast=false)
methods.description: Reshapes and views a nested tensor as a dense tensor suitable for attention kernel inputs, handling broadcasting and batching.

methods.name: std::tuple<Tensor,Tensor,Tensor,Tensor,Tensor,int64_t,int64_t,Tensor> sdpa_nested_preprocessing(const Tensor & query,const Tensor & key,const Tensor & value)
methods.description: Preprocesses nested query, key, and value tensors for attention, handling batching and broadcasting, outputting reshaped dense tensors and associated metadata.

methods.name: std::tuple<Tensor,Tensor,Tensor,Tensor,Tensor> sdpa_nested_preprocessing_backward(const at::Tensor & grad_out_,const at::Tensor & query,const at::Tensor & key,const at::Tensor & value,const at::Tensor & out,const Tensor & cumulative_sequence_length_q,const Tensor & cumulative_sequence_length_kv,const int64_t max_seqlen_batch_q,const int64_t max_seqlen_batch_kv)
methods.description: Prepares tensors for the backward pass of nested tensor attention, reshaping gradients and inputs as dense tensors.

methods.name: auto sdpa_nested_preprocessing_with_broadcast(const Tensor & query,const Tensor & key,const Tensor & value)
